title: sdk-docs-todo-scratchpad
content:
Personal scratchpad / running to-do list for SDK docs (quick, informal).

Context:
- Maintaining SDK docs + sample apps for hosted API, Dedicated, and Private. Need to triage doc gaps that block onboarding and PLG flows.
- Focus: examples, streaming docs, error handling, function/tool-calling examples, and minimal reproducible samples for common patterns.

Top priorities (high-level)
1) Fix README example in Python quickstart (blocking signup->first-call funnel) [PR referenced above]
   - Issue: example uses deprecated args; users get 400 with new SDK v1.4.
   - Quick fix: update call signature and add small snippet showing streaming vs non-streaming.
   - Owner: me. ETA: tomorrow demo to growth.

2) Add Node + Go minimal sample apps (chat + embeddings)
   - Node: express-based chat sample that streams tokens to client. Show server-side SSE example.
   - Go: simple CLI that produces embeddings and saves to sqlite. Use our new pagination helper.
   - JIRA: JIRA-ENG-879 (integration tests + CI job).

3) Streaming docs (SDK + API)
   - Document how to resume a dropped stream and recommended socket timeouts.
   - Add note about running behind proxies/load balancers (NGINX chunked encoding tips).
   - Link to platform SRE doc (TODO: request internal link from SRE).

4) Function/tool-calling examples (JS/TS)
   - Create 2 short examples: (a) tool lookup + call on user intent, (b) fallback to smaller model for non-critical tasks.
   - Add test harness in examples/ that runs locally with MOCK_TOOL env.

5) Private deployment considerations in SDK docs
   - Config knobs for custom endpoints, auth tokens, and client-side TLS. Make sure examples show VPC/private URL format.
   - Confirm env var names match CLI config (sso vs api_key).

Medium/low priorities
- Caching example: show prefix caching and KV cache hints for chat apps. Could be a short appendix rather than full sample.
- Retry/backoff patterns: add recommended exponential backoff helper and show idempotency notes for generate vs embeddings.
- Error mapping section: map common platform errors -> SDK exceptions and suggested operator actions.

Open questions / items to triage
- Who owns updating the console screenshots in the docs? (Pinged @Priya).
- Need final wording for SLA section 14 legal review required.
- Is there a canonical example for quantized models that we can link to? Research/Applied ML might have something.

Quick notes (to paste into PRs)
- \"update quickstart: use client = RedwoodClient({ baseURL: process.env.RW_API_URL || 'https://api.redwood.ai', apiKey: process.env.RW_API_KEY })\"
- streaming: recommend client.stream({ model: 'gptx-stream-lite' }) with reconnect logic.

Local dev commands (notes to self)
- run node sample: RW_API_KEY=devkey RW_API_URL=http://localhost:8080 node examples/node-chat/server.js
- run go sample: RW_API_KEY=devkey RW_API_URL=http://localhost:8080 go run examples/go-emb/main.go
- run local doc preview: yarn workspace docs start (watch)

Quick triage checklist before shipping a doc change
- [ ] README examples run end-to-end locally
- [ ] CI example tests pass (examples/*)
- [ ] Add short e2e snippet to integration-test matrix (PR comment)
- [ ] Link to GH issue or JIRA in the PR description
- [ ] Add CHANGELOG entry if behavior change or breaking examples

Notes to self / rough timeline
- Fri: patch README + small streaming note. Get Alex to review.
- Mon: Node sample skeleton + PR for examples repo.
- Tue: Go sample + add to CI.
- End of week: Docs pass for quickstart funnel and send to product for wording check.

Scratchbrain / things I might try later
- Interactive tutorial: embed a playable code block in docs that runs against a mocked endpoint (like runnable playground). Worth prototyping as a demo for new users.
- Short video walkthrough for streaming use-case (~2 min).

Slack refs / inbox
- Slack thread: #devexp-sdk -> \"streaming behavior behind proxies\" (link in PR)
- Waiting on review from: Alex, Priya, Marco

Unresolved small TODOs (quick list)
- add TLS example for private (client cert) -> ask infra for example cert config
- update version table in README (v1.3 -> v1.4)
- check Windows path quirks in Go sample (slashes)

End of scratchpad (save and ship incremental PRs).

-- Samantha
